notes.title: Back to School Update - Ver. 1.4.0 - 20% Off!
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Check Devlog Video
[p align="start"]Hey fellow socks! School is almost back in session, and we’ve got fresh content dropping today to kick off the chaos in style. Here’s what’s landing with today’s update: 


🏫 New Courtroom: FINAL EXAM TRIAL
What better way to kick off the school year than with a courtroom themed around the chaos of academic life?

This new map blends school nostalgia with legal drama. Lockers, chalkboards, and that uncomfortable feeling of being called on when you weren’t paying attention.

The Final Exam Trial is available right now!


🧢 Upcoming Cosmetics
Now available in-game:

Costumes: Two classic school uniforms and one Japanese-style uniform

Hats: Playful accessories to match your schoolyard persona

Eyes: New expressive eyes inspired by childhood innocence

Accessories: A pair of nerdy glasses and a shiny dental brace 😬

Sock Patterns: Retro sock designs you definitely wore in gym class
[p align="start"]Get ready to sharpen those pencils and prepare your best objections, class starts today! 🧦✏️


💨 Fart updates
Yes, new farts added.



As always, if you spot bugs or have feedback, jump into the Discord and let us know!


Enjoying the courtroom chaos? Leave us a Steam review!
Your feedback helps us grow the community!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433718/db570292fe3ecd184997492795095f971617c01c.gif"]

notes.title: [Not so] Weekly Update #4 - New musics and what's to come!
notes.content:
📚 No Weekly Update? Blame the Holidays!
Hey fellow socks!  We’re skipping some weekly updates: the team is off enjoying a well-deserved break (sun, sand, and maybe a few courtroom cocktails). But don’t get too comfortable... 

Because when the school bell rings this fall, you better be seated, sharpened, and terrified. 🧦

The next content drop is set to land in time for the 2025 back-to-school season. And while we can’t show you too much yet, we’ll just say this:

- 🏫 Dust off your dunce caps.

- 🦷 Polish those braces.

- 📏 And prepare for a courtroom where detention is just the beginning.

Until then, enjoy the summer break, and don’t forget to do your homework.

We'll be back soon, and class will be in session.


🎵 Bonus: Music to Judge By
While we’ve been getting some sun, we did sneak a few updates into the game!

We’ve added original music tracks to spice up the courtroom atmosphere:

- 🎻 Pirate, Medieval, and Default courtrooms now have their own custom tunes

- 🎹 Unique music cues added for Prosecutor charges


Enjoying the courtroom chaos? Leave us a Steam review!
Your feedback helps us grow the community!

notes.title: Weekly Update #2 - Ver. 1.1.0
notes.content:
✅ New Features
Votekick System: Got a disruptive player in your game? You can now votekick mid-trial! Just open the ESC menu, click on a player’s icon, and start a vote with your fellow socks. Democracy has entered the courtroom.
NB: This system is designed to quickly remove disruptive players, but keep in mind: if a major role gets kicked, you won't be able to end the trial. A smoother solution is in the works! 


New Courtroom: "Lights, Camera, Trial!"
Ever wanted to argue your case on national TV? This new TV set-themed courtroom brings drama, glamour, and way too many cameras. 
🧢Cosmetics
3 New Costumes: Direct from the costume department of SockTV!

3 New Accessories: Style your sock with the latest courtroom trends.

3 New Hairstyles: Whether you're going for professional, chaotic, or “woke up 5 minutes before court,” we’ve got you.

notes.title: Thanks for enjoying the game!
notes.content:
We’re Blown Away
First off: a massive THANK YOU for playing the demo, and an even bigger thank you for diving into the full game!

Honestly, we weren’t ready for this much love. You showed up, played hard, and made us seriously sweaty while we were hotfixing stuff.

It’s been amazing to see a community growing around the game, and from such wildly different backgrounds, too. We’re honored to have you all aboard this slightly chaotic ride.

Demo: Time to Say Goodbye (Cue the Sad Violin)
We hope you’ve had fun with the demo! The team really wanted to leave it up for the first weekend of the release. We hope it gave you a good taste of the core mechanics and helped you prepare for the full experience!

Since we want to focus on improving the full game, and because the demo no longer reflects the final version, we’ll be taking it offline in 24 hours. So if you were planning to try the demo tonight, have one last hurrah with your mates before it goes offline.

That said, we’re not ruling out bringing back a demo for special events in the future, although it would be a different version. We’ll keep you posted!

What's Coming Next
Now for the juicy part: the full game has more updates in the pipeline than a coffee-fueled coder in crunch time (like we are right now).

Thanks to all your suggestions and feedback on Discord, we’re starting to prioritize the most requested features.

The first update is dropping this week, with new cosmetics and some quality-of-life improvements. We’ll talk more about those QoL upgrades in a future post (good cliffhanger, huh?).

Fashion Week: Sock Edition
Let’s talk style. We’re adding:

Hats (for stylish heads)
Accessories (for dramatic flair)
New eyes (for maximum judgmental stares)
Costumes (because why not go full fabulous?)

The costumes are being chosen by YOU on Discord, so hop in next time and make your voice heard!

Thanks a Million
Once again, thank you for making all of this possible.

We’re working our socks off to make the game even better, and we genuinely hope the upcoming updates will make you laugh, cry (happy tears only), and smash that "START AGAIN" button.

May the Sock be with you.

– Demon Max Team

notes.title: D-DAY! The game is OUT for $4.95!
notes.content:
Get your best socks ready, the trials of Guilty as Sock! begin TODAY!

The game officially launches today 🎉! If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to join our AWESOME Discord server!

A huge thank you for all the support over the past few days, it truly means a lot to us, and we’re so happy to see how excited you are about the game’s concept!

Since we’re a very small team, we’ll now be focusing all our efforts on improving the full game. That means we won’t be updating the demo for a little while.

Frequently Asked Questions

💰 How much does the game cost?
The game is priced at $4.95 at launch.

👯‍♀️ Do all my friends need to own the game to play together?
Yes, each player needs to own the full version to join someone else’s lobby.

🌍 What languages are available?
English, Spanish, and French. We’re considering adding more languages once the initial post-release phase is over.

🧪 What’s different from the demo?
A lot! We covered the new content in detail in this post from two days ago.

🗣️ Is TTS (text-to-speech) available at launch?
Not yet, but it’s a feature we plan to add after the post-release phase!

During the first few weeks after launch, our top priority will be polishing the overall experience. Once that’s done, we’ll gather your suggestions and start adding new content.

Thanks again for your enthusiasm, see you in court! 🧦⚖️

notes.title: D-3 before the release of Guilty as Sock!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

On the agenda: the release date, the price, and a reminder of what's new in the full game!

Release Date and Trailer
We announced the release date of Guilty as Sock! last Thursday — it's coming out on 05/29! Missed it? Here's the trailer link.

Price
This has been asked many times on our (awesome) Discord server, and here’s the answer:

The price will be $4.95 at launch!!!!!!!!!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433718/ecd7209673cb12f241d2fb4e35d6c251b8a2c819.gif

New Content
You’ll find all the details on the store page, but here are the most important ones:

 New roles: Bailiff, Journalist, Witness, and Juror! They’re secondary roles, but they add some spice to every new trial!
 Cosmetics: You'll be able to choose the sock that suits you best: sock color, eyes, accessories, and costumes... Everything to create the sock of your dreams.
 Maps: In addition to the default courtroom, you’ll be able to play in a Sci-Fi courtroom or a medieval one! Perfect for RP fans.
 Core system overhaul: new card distribution system, revamped judge's gavel mechanics...
 Twitch feature: Streamers can ask their chat to vote, letting them decide Guilty or Not Guilty throughout the trial!


More and more of you have shown interest in the game, and we really hope you’re going to enjoy it! Feel free to join the Discord server to share your feedback — we welcome all types!

May the sock be with you.

– Demon Max Team
